verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents a management API and offers an LLM-oriented markdown API reference, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. A prose markdown reference is an adjacent feature, not a machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The PlanetScale API allows you to manage your PlanetScale databases programmatically.
